description: CrazyGames rewarded-ad fix. The auto-reward was firing only the Reward listener event, but the web finishes the rewarded flow (credits the reward and dismisses the loading overlay) on the Dismissed event, gated on Reward having fired first. So it stuck on the loading screen. Now fires Reward then Dismissed (in order) for both showRewardVideoAd and showRewardInterstitialAd, then resolves the call. Other patches unchanged: Bypass Play license check, Remove ads, Disable analytics, Remove AD_ID, Change app name.
